integrity: The classification is an analytic result, supported by a reproducible finite rational and high-precision numerical checker; finite tests do not establish its infinite assertions. Earlier contributions to forward-projection recurrence and survivor-set calculations are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Single continuous observation window per period and fixed nonintegral travel time only. No stochastic timing, variable inputs, multiple windows, or coupled neurons. An equivalent older theorem for a reset rotation with a hole cannot be completely ruled out.
title: Arithmetic capture and exact firing-rate staircases on periodic observation windows
